note: Mission Composer layer 4 (vision plan 4.2): turns. A twist lands mid-mission and always offers a choice whose answer becomes story (arc outcome and a deed). Hail lines are hand-written; {requester} and {target} are filled in code.

hails: Hold fire. Whatever {requester} is paying you, I can beat it. Take my money and let me go, and nobody has to know.
Wait. Before you finish this, ask yourself why {requester} wants me dead and not in a cell. I'll pay more than they will.
Cease fire. I'm not the story you were sold. Walk away from {requester}'s job and I'll make it worth your while.
Listen. {requester} is using you to clean up their mess. I can pay you better than they can, right now, clean.
I'm powering down. Weapons cold. You've won. Please, just let me go home.
Stop, please. I surrender. My drives are dead and I've got people waiting for me. You don't have to do this.
All right, it's over, I yield. Shields down, guns off. I'll leave this system and never come back. Just let me live.
Don't. I'm done, I'm out. Whatever {requester} told you about me, I'm not worth the shot.
